name: Oakhaven Borderlands
theme: Classic Frontier Sanctuary & Hex Wilderness (Legacy Baseline)
hazardTable: Rockslide in the foothills (DC 12 DEX or 2d6 bludgeoning)
Stagnant sinkhole gases (DC 11 CON or 1 fatigue)
Thorny briar thicket (DC 10 STR or lose 1 torch/ration)
Sudden subterranean fissure (DC 13 DEX or slip near edge)
weatherTable: Clear blue skies with crisp mountain wind
Chilly morning frost and amber leaves

factions.name: Oakhaven Guard
factions.notes: Protect the sanctuary basin and maintain peace within the walls.

factions.name: Glimmercap Tinkers
factions.notes: Trade potions, salvage clockwork curios, and explore strange ruins.

factions.name: Iron Gorge Clan
factions.notes: Secure iron shipments and defend mountain passes against goblin raiders.

entryConditions: Expedition access point into Oakhaven Borderlands.
exitConditions: Waymarked return route to Oakhaven Sanctuary.
